mapper.select: SELECT id, biz_type, biz_id, target_user_id, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, last_error, tenant_id, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at, sent_at, created_by, updated_by FROM a_message_notify_outbox WHERE status = 0 AND next_retry_at <= #{now} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY next_retry_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE a_message_notify_outbox SET status = 1, sent_at = #{sentAt}, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE a_message_notify_outbox SET status = 2, last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE a_message_notify_outbox SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
